data.name: PromptDowngrade
data.value: A commercial card transaction settled in the interchange category "{0}". Call the lint_payload tool with the payload below. List the findings that likely explain why it settled there rather than at a lower enhanced-data rate, most likely cause first, and say for each one what to change. Findings are advisory: say "likely" rather than certain, and note when the category does not match any finding.{1}Payload:{1}{2}

data.name: PromptReview
data.value: Call the lint_payload tool with the payload below. Then explain each error in plain words, one short paragraph each: what is wrong, why the card brand cares, and the fix. Call suggest_fixes and show the patch. Finally list the findings that need a person to decide, such as product descriptions, commodity codes and tax amounts, which must never be invented.{1}Payload:{1}{0}

data.name: ServerInstructions
data.value: l3lint checks commercial card Level 2 and Level 3 payment payloads against Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover requirements before submission. Call lint_payload with the request body you are about to send; it detects Stripe, Adyen, Braintree, Cybersource, Authorize.net, Checkout.com and canonical JSON. Use explain_rule for any rule ID you do not understand and suggest_fixes for safe mechanical patches. Never invent descriptions, commodity codes or tax amounts to clear a finding. Results are advisory, not a guarantee of any interchange rate.

data.value: Usage: l3lint-mcp [--http] [--port <n>] [--token <token>] [--allow-origin <origin>]... [--version] [--help]. Default transport: stdio. --http serves Streamable HTTP at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp (default port 7341). The token can also come from the L3LINT_MCP_TOKEN environment variable.
